notes.title: v1.20 Release!
notes.notes:
Fix black screen blinking when player changes the floor of dungeon and so on.
Fix unnecessary error detection when player unlocks the trophy with server problem
Update the latest English text

notes.title: v1.10 has been released! Finally, English version is supported!
notes.notes:
Hi, all.
We have released the English version of Labyrinth of Touhou!
You can play English now.
And Trading cards and some community items are released too.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: ver1.07 release!
notes.notes:
Add key config.
Show key config as how to control at first run.
Add the new moving control in dungeon. (1: input "up" / move to "up right", 2: input "up" move to "up left", 3: input "up right" / move to "up right)
Show version on top menu.
Change to be enable run the game when PC doesn't connect Internet.
Fix the problem which is "Windows slow" by switching task when fullscreen mode in some PC environment.
Modify Chinese translation.
